fullPassage: The introduction of scientific methods into medical practice transformed the profession as well as its object. Until the late nineteenth century, doctors were not required to have studied medicine and were relied on mainly to provide comfort and guidance to their patients. As the practice of medicine shifted from cure to prevention, doctors were now expected to provide results based on scientific evidence. As a result of this access to forms of knowledge beyond the understanding of the general public, more authority and power was granted to the medical profession, and the nature of the doctor/patient relationship changed. Once the source of a disease was identified, patients expected that doctors should be able to cure them. Additionally, those doctors with scientific training were now distinguished from a range of alternative healers, from homeopaths to midwives, resulting in an elevation in the eyes of the public of the status of the profession as compared with other healing practices, which persists today.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ expecting → expected: 의사들이 결과를 제공하도록 '기대받는' 것이므로 수동태 were expected.
det.analysis:
❌ ① transformed: 주어 The introduction + 과거동사. 정상

✅ ③ expecting(오류): 'doctors were now expecting to provide results' — 의사들이 결과 제공을 '기대받는' 것이므로 수동태 were expected가 필요. 능동 진행형 were expecting은 '의사가 기대하고 있다'가 되어 문맥·어법 모두 부적절 ← 정답

questions.passage: The introduction of scientific methods into medical practice transformed the profession as well as its object. Until the late nineteenth century, doctors were not required to have studied medicine and were relied on mainly to provide comfort and guidance to their patients. As the practice of medicine shifted from cure to prevention, doctors were now expected to provide results based on scientific evidence. As a result of this access to forms of knowledge beyond the understanding of the general public, more authority and power was granted to the medical profession, and the nature of the doctor/patient relationship changed. Once the source of a disease was identified, patients expected that doctors should be able to cure them. Additionally, those doctors with scientific training were now distinguished from a range of alternative healers, from homeopaths to midwives, resulting in an elevation in the eyes of the public of the status of the profession as compared with other healing practices, which persists today.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 과학적 방법 도입 → 의료 전문직의 위상·성격 변화. 글 전체 주제.
det.analysis:
✅ ① ← 정답: 과학적 방법이 직업을 변형(S1) → 역할 변화(S2~3) → 권위 부여(S4) → 지위 상승(S6). 글 전체 흐름

❌ ④ 예방 생활 습관: cure→prevention 언급은 있으나 생활 습관은 아님
det.tip: 글의 핵심 = 과학화가 의료 전문직에 가져온 변화(권위·지위).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로)

det.korean: patients(환자들은) expected(기대했다) that(~라고) doctors should be able to cure them(의사가 자신을 치료할 수 있어야 한다고)
det.analysis: 구문 분석: patients(주어) + expected(동사) + that절(목적어). that절 내부는 doctors(주어) + should be able to(조동사+be able to) + cure(동사원형) + them(목적어). '치료할 수 있어야 한다'는 should be able to cure로 표현
det.tip: should be able to + 동사원형 = ~할 수 있어야 한다. that절이 expected의 목적어.
